the_warden: Secure the inner districts and prevent any uprising by working alongside skilled yet variable-commitment soldiers. Engage them in planning and patrols to keep morale high and ensure no resistance can take root again.
the_marshal: Hold strategic points with eager but less experienced troops. Guide them step-by-step to fortify gates, bridges, and posts, turning their loyalty into disciplined, effective defense.
architect: Clear forests and gardens of any enemy remnants using elite, self-driven soldiers. Trust them to adapt and innovate while securing every hiding place without constant oversight.
overseer: Restore movement routes and strengthen military infrastructure with raw recruits. Issue clear, strict orders and closely monitor every step to ensure speed and accuracy.
commander: Control the Valoria River with inexperienced troops by enforcing strict discipline. Guard every pier, patrol the waters, and block all unauthorized movement under tight command.

DRAR.1: Deploying forces to secure rooftops of high-rise buildings first
DRAR.2: Conducting a thorough sweeping operation from street to street
DRAR.3: Deploying forces as a surprise from back doors

AWS.1: Building an additional bridge in the area to reinforce the engineering teams
AWS.2: Assigning forces to patrol the city's streets
AWS.3: Sealing the western entrances of the city to prevent enemy infiltration
AWS.4: Consumes engineering resources in inappropriate tasks
AWS.5: Conflicts with the rest of the internal visits

SLAM.1: Deploying light units using natural terrain as cover to ambush and extract the enemy
SLAM.2: Setting fire to the location to force resistance
SLAM.3: Building concrete walls in green areas to isolate them
SLAM.4: Causes the city to lose its natural and strategic value
SLAM.5: Massive effort without tactical value and hinders mobility

BOTHER.1: Establishing water barriers to block any boats or ships
BOTHER.2: Setting up complete inspection points and running patrols around the river
BOTHER.3: Moving part of the front to the other bank and completely evacuating the river

SABET.1: Leading the attack from inside the city with backup forces to support the advance
SABET.2: Fortifying the perimeter of the main roundabout and establishing a permanent observation post
SABET.3: Sending forces to monitor the outer borders of the city
SABET.4: Out of scope and exposes friendly forces to chaos
